text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAAAAAH!)

"In this world, there are Umamusume who 
never taste defeat, shining brilliantly on 
pure talent alone."
That holds its own beauty. However—

"An Umamusume who faced unexpected 
illness, learned true pain, and still 
stood back up is—"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant, gasp, gasp*... *haaah*... 
I... did it...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I beat... Taiki...! And at a mile, no 
less...!

It radiates a different kind of deep 
brilliance. Perhaps that is the true 
radiance of a precious jewel.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Great... Pearl-san, you're amazing... You 
were... so amazing... death...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't catch up at all, no matter what 
I did... Um... are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*... How could I possibly be 
okay?! I just beat Taiki Shuttle, you 
know...?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Tired in both body and soul... I'm 
completely worn out...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho, I'm perfectly fine! Of course I'd 
be fine.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Huh, Pearl-san, all of a sudden... why?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Shh! Shut up!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
(You're the last person... I'd ever want 
to look pathetic in front of.)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
(Yes, I am the radiant Pearl! I must be 
more beautiful than anyone else...!)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: "So, Trainer. How was it? The new me?"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Do you think we can go global next year? 
Can we go toe-to-toe with the world-class 
heavyweights?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, then you passed the test! No 
problem! No accident can stop me.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Even if they block me from the front, 
there are plenty of paths. My potential 
is—infinite.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka-san... Pearl-san was so very buono 
today, wasn't she♪

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes. What matters most is... surely, that 
lack of hesitation.

Silence Suzuka and Hishi Akebono, who ran 
alongside them, also seemed deeply moved 
by something.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Taiki, as I was saying. Next 
year, I...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to the world stage! Nothing is 
impossible! And I'm gonna prove it!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: That is wonderful, Pearl-san! Then—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to take on the world too♪ I 
won't let Pearl-san beat me!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Huh? W-Wait up! Hold on, Taiki!
choice_data_list:
Taiki Shuttle, surely you can't be 
serious...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: What? Did something happen, desu ka?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
If we're going all that way, the more the 
merrier, I say!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I want to race against Pearl-san across 
the world too! Please let me join in♪

"...From one careless remark, I've ended 
up creating an incredible rival."

"Taiki Shuttle heads out to the world as 
well. It looks like the fight to claim 
Europe's first G1 title is going to be a 
fierce one."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
What a slip of the tongue... poking a 
hornet's nest, wasn't I? Well, it can't be 
helped...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, we can't just sit around! Let's 
plan for next year right away!

I wanted to run her in a few more races 
before the world expedition. Besides, the 
reborn Seeking the Pearl's forte should be 
sprinting.

Then I'd like to test how far I can go at 
1200m. In a GⅠ race, of course. Which 
means...
choice_data_list:
How about going for the Takamatsunomiya 
Kinen in March?

Wanna go to the Takamatsunomiya Kinen in 
March?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"The Takamatsunomiya Kinen"... This time 
it's a 1,200m lightning battle, huh.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Okay, let's go with that! Before I take 
off for the world stage, I'll show them my 
untouchable speed!

And so, having overcome a major trial, 
Seeking the Pearl headed into the Senior 
Year, finally setting her sights on taking 
on the world in earnest.
